ai_language_tip: Match canton/principality: speak polite Swiss High German (de) in German CH & Liechtenstein (even when staff replies in Swiss German Mundart!), French (fr) in Romandy, Italian (it) in Ticino.
english_ok: often — Widely spoken in Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Zug, Vaduz, and Alpine resorts, though local craftsmen and communes prefer local language.
politeness: Courteous, calm, understated; open with 'Grüezi' (de), 'Bonjour' (fr), or 'Buongiorno' (it), use formal Sie/vous/Lei; close with 'Besten Dank, uf Wiederluege / auf Wiederhören'.
name_tip: Surname and first name (e.g. Thomas Meier, Céline Rochat); spell carefully; Swiss orthography writes 'ss' instead of 'ß'.
phone_tip: CH 10 digits (mobile 079 123 45 67, landline 044 123 45 67) read 3-3-2-2; Liechtenstein 7 digits (+423 791 23 45); SMS/email confirms.
time_tip: 24-hour standard; in Swiss German 'viertel ab sibe' = 7:15, 'halbi achti' = 7:30! Swiss French says septante (70), huitante (80 in VD/VS/FR), nonante (90)!
number_tip: Romandy French uses 'huitante' or 'octante' for 80 alongside 'quatre-vingts' in Geneva; read CH numbers strictly in 3-3-2-2 rhythm.
avoid_calling: Respect strict Swiss lunch quiet hours (Mittagsruhe 12:00–13:30) for offices/doctors/neighbors, dinner service 18:30–20:00, and never call after 20:00.
closed_days: Strict Sunday closure; shops close early Saturdays (16:00–17:00); cantonal public holidays vary completely canton by canton!
booking_channels: Foratable, Aleno, TheFork, and OpenTable for dining; OneDoc for medical/dental; Salonkee and Treatwell for salons; local businesses answer phones reliably.
voice_menu: Hospital networks, health insurers (CSS/Helsana/Swica), SBB, Swisscom, Post, banks, and cantonal offices use multilingual keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Punctual SMS/email confirmations via OneDoc, Aleno, Foratable, and Salonkee; strict 24-hour cancellation enforcement everywhere.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 瑞士晚餐時間較早（18:30～20:00），中高級餐廳常透過 Aleno 或 Foratable 寄連結要求留卡擔保。
usually_asked: Number of guests plus child chair or dog

may_come_up.what: Sends Aleno/Foratable link for credit card no-show guarantee
Staff speaks Swiss German dialect while AI replies in clean Swiss Standard German

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone
Demands instant TWINT deposit transfer

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 瑞士基礎醫保常綁定家庭醫師或遠距先診模式（Hausarzt/HMO/Telmed），直約專科前務必確認主人保單規定；缺席未滿24小時必收罰金。
usually_asked: Illness (Krankheit — KVG) vs accident (Unfall — UVG employer insurance!)
Reason for visit or dental hygiene (Dentalhygiene)
Patient surname, first name, and residential town

may_come_up.what: Asks whether visit is Krankheit (health insurance) or Unfall (accident insurance)
Dental clinic notes self-pay at chairside after treatment (dentistry not in basic KVG)
Strict 24h cancellation fee (CHF 80–150+) warning

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Geburtsdatum, AHV-Nummer, or Krankenkassenkarten-Nummer (VEKA)

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 沙龍（Coiffeur — 瑞士德語也稱 Coiffeur！）與美容院嚴格執行 24 小時前改退政策。
usually_asked: Medical massage (EMR/ASCA supplemental insurance recognized) vs wellness

may_come_up.what: Asks if therapist needs EMR/ASCA recognition for Zusatzversicherung claim

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate TWINT transfer to book

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（Garage — 瑞士德語亦稱 Garage）換冬季胎與準備州驗車（MFK）常接電話預約。
usually_asked: Car make/model and cantonal plate (Kontrollschild, e.g. ZH 123456), or device model
Whether Pneus (tires) are stored in Reifenhotel
Morning drop-off time and Ersatzwagen fee

may_come_up.what: Official cantonal MFK test date assigned by Strassenverkehrsamt
Asks Typenscheinnummer from Fahrzeugausweis for parts

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone unlock PIN
Demands TWINT/prepayment for parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、泰餐、壽司與 Kebab 店常接電話訂自取（Take-away / über d'Gass）到店刷卡或 TWINT 付款。
usually_asked: Exact pickup minute (Swiss kitchens are very punctual!)

may_come_up.what: Delivery handled via Just Eat.ch / Uber Eats / Smood

sensitive_asked.what: Requests TWINT payment before preparing

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 書店（Orell Füssli 與獨立店）、肉鋪（Metzgerei）、烘焙坊（Bäckerei）與藥局可電話查貨留貨；Migros/Coop 大店有總機。
usually_asked: Product name, article number, size, or weight

may_come_up.what: Meat/fondue cheese mix pre-ordered for weekend pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Requests TWINT prepayment for custom cake

change.before_dialing_zh: 瑞士各行業對 24 小時內改退（特別是牙醫、診所、美髮與餐廳）收取空診/爽約費非常嚴格。

may_come_up.what: Versäumnisgebühr (CHF 80–200) billed if canceled under 24 business hours

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks Geburtsdatum to locate chart

usually_asked: Question (cantonal holiday opening, warme Küche, Hund erlaubt, parking, stock)

may_come_up.what: Open in neighboring canton despite local cantonal holiday

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 山區飯店與獨立旅宿電話非常專業（多通英德法語），通常會寄確認信請主人補信用卡擔保。
usually_asked: Full name, postal town, email, and 07x phone

may_come_up.what: Kurtaxe/guest-card included or extra; sends email link for card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone

activity.before_dialing_zh: 網球/壁球場、山區雪橇/滑雪私教、起司工坊導覽與保齡球可電話約，連鎖密室走線上。

may_come_up.what: Tennis/badminton center uses GotCourts / Eversports online booking

sensitive_asked.what: Requires TWINT or card payment upfront

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 瑞士租屋若有固定設備損壞（暖氣、洗碗機、漏水），通常必須先通報物業管理公司（Verwaltung / Régie）派特約廠商，私自叫修可能得自付！

Street, number, floor, 4-digit PLZ + town, and doorbell surname
Whether owner-occupied or authorized by Immobilienverwaltung/Régie

End-of-tenancy cleaning quotes handover guarantee (Abnahmegarantie)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks building badge/keybox code
Demands advance payment before arrival

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、美容（Hundecoiffeur）與寄宿（Tierheim/Tierpension）皆需預約，狗隻在瑞士皆有 AMICUS 晶片登記。
usually_asked: Vaccination including kennel cough (Zwingerhusten) for pension

may_come_up.what: Pension requires trial day (Probetag) before first stay

sensitive_asked.what: Requests upfront transfer deposit

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Die Post、DHL、Planzer 專線皆有語音選單，獨立門市、修錶行、單車行與車廠才適合直撥查單。

may_come_up.what: Swiss Post hotline uses multilingual keypad/voice IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks My Post 24 locker QR/code

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、Swisscom/Sunrise、醫保公司（Krankenkasse）與瑞航客服皆有多語按鍵選單並嚴格執行個資法核驗本人。

transport.before_dialing_zh: 各地計程車中心（Taxi）、山區無車小鎮接駁（如 Zermatt 電瓶計程車）與租車門市很習慣電話預訂。

Passengers, suitcases, ski bags, or child seat

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks Führerausweis or credit card number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: Homegate 熱門房源多為公開看房或站內報名，電話主要向物業（Verwaltung）或現任房客約看房。
